newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar rallies on Q1, Triton down.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar rallies on Q1, Triton down.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp shares rallied 3/4 to 31-1/4 after the company reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.35, up from a proforma $0.28 a year ago.
The analyst consensus for the refiner was $0.19 per share before exceptional items, according to First Call.
A one time gain of $11.0 million came from the sale of an office building.

Exploration and production company Triton shares fell 1/4 to 36-1/4 after the company reported a slide in net income per share to $0.09 from $0.29 a year ago after exceptional items, or $0.12 versus $0.10 a year ago before exceptionals. Analysts had expected $0.14 before exceptional items, according to First Call.

The company said revenues for the year-ago quarter included $6.2 million from businesses that have since been sold and adjusting for that, the first-quarter 1997 revenue of $33.8 million would have been 14 percent higher than 1996 first-quarter revenues of $29.6 million, the company said.
